mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalAlerts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unresolvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as resolvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_level = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as criticalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_level = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highCount FROM biz_risk_alert
SELECT id, alert_type, alert_level, title, content, dept_id, status, alert_time, resolve_time FROM biz_risk_alert ORDER BY alert_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT alert_type, COUNT(*) as \`count\` FROM biz_risk_alert GROUP BY alert_type ORDER BY \`count\` DESC
SELECT alert_level, COUNT(*) as count FROM biz_risk_alert GROUP BY alert_level ORDER BY alert_level DESC
SELECT DATE(alert_time) as alertDate, COUNT(*) as alertCount FROM biz_risk_alert WHERE alert_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(alert_time) ORDER BY alertDate
